label: No reward after a1 to rare S2 (stay-on-a1 evidence), at D1 and at the next S1 arrival
explanation: Fires only on non-GO steps that follow an unrewarded trial (in_rew = 0 on 100% of activations, never with reward input 1). That previous trial was an a1 choice that landed in S2 by a rare transition (or it lies before the window, so its transition is unknown). This is the rare-unrewarded case, where a model-based agent should stay on a1, and the agent does choose a1 on this trial. The unit fires at D1, which holds 78% of activation mass and all of the strongest activations (about 0.7-1.0 of max). It fires again more weakly (about 0.1-0.25 of max) at D2 when this a1 choice reaches S1. It never fires at GO, after an a2 choice, when the reached state is S2, or after a rewarded trial. Activity is concentrated where S1 is good (84% of mass) and where the policy logit for a1 is moderately positive (2.8 to 8). It is silent when the a1 preference is extreme. Adding that choice band raises dev F1 from 0.74 to 0.79. The recorded predicate uses action at D1, which is the agent own upcoming choice (allowed). At D2 the action is already observed. Precision is about 0.61: the false positives are mostly the same context with no activation, for example at the trial right after a reversal. Dev: P 0.61, R 0.95, F1 0.74, mass recall 0.995.
